kind: Page-length measuring guard (layout budget section 2, owner decision of 4 November 2026) and its first baseline. Report only: nothing fails on a value yet.
findingsNote: No GAP id is created or changed. The measured values are a baseline, not acceptance.
sensitive: no: tests and a record only

method.measure: Full document height (documentElement.scrollHeight or body.scrollHeight, whichever is larger) divided by the viewport height, rounded to two places.
method.routes: docs/revamp/COVERAGE.json page routes only (62 of the 126 entries: the file is a page.tsx; the rest are route.ts endpoints). 45 static and 17 with a dynamic segment.
method.notMeasuredRule: A route that redirects, answers an error, has a dynamic segment with no fixture, or needs a session or private link is recorded as not measured with its reason, never as a value.
files: tests/ux/page-length-lib.ts (shared measure, thresholds, owner mapping, report writer)
tests/ux/page-length.spec.ts (public pages on the UX gate server)
tests/e2e/verification/ws-e/team-page-length.spec.ts (team workspace as the seeded owner, plus the staff and contributor pages that need no session)
method.reportFiles: work/page-length/ux-gate.json and work/page-length/team.json (gitignored; the values are copied below).
